skill.name: fetching-library-docs
skill.description: Fetches focused library documentation through Context7 MCP and filters results into compact examples, API signatures, and notes for coding assistants.
skill.summary: Fetch focused library documentation with token-efficient Context7 filtering.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown examples, shell-script syntax, and Context7 MCP documentation. Real risks remain because the skill runs external npm-based MCP code and bundles a generic stdio MCP client that uses shell=True for caller-provided commands.

remediation.issue: Generic stdio MCP execution uses shell=True for arbitrary command strings.
remediation.suggestion: Replace shell=True with an argument-vector API, restrict allowed MCP server commands, or remove generic stdio support from the published skill.

remediation.issue: The skill runs npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp during documentation fetches.
remediation.suggestion: Document the network and package-execution requirement clearly, pin the package version, and require user confirmation before first execution.

remediation.issue: Server helper scripts trust predictable PID files in /tmp.
remediation.suggestion: Store PID files in a user-owned runtime directory or validate the process command before sending termination signals.

content.value_statement: Developers often need current library examples without loading large documentation pages into context. This skill fetches Context7 documentation and returns compact code examples, API signatures, and key notes.
actual_capabilities: Resolves common library names to Context7-compatible library IDs.
Fetches current documentation for a selected library topic.
Filters documentation into code examples, API signatures, and important notes.
Supports code and informational modes for different documentation needs.
Provides pagination support for deeper documentation exploration.
limitations: Requires network access and npm execution for the Context7 MCP server.
Only covers libraries available through Context7 documentation indexes.
Filtering can omit useful context from long documentation pages.
Shell scripts require a Unix-like environment with Python available.

use_cases.title: Find API examples quickly
use_cases.description: Fetch concise examples for a specific framework feature without reading full documentation pages.

use_cases.title: Learn a new library workflow
use_cases.description: Use info mode for an overview, then code mode for focused examples on the next implementation step.

use_cases.title: Reduce context usage during coding
use_cases.description: Return filtered documentation snippets so an assistant can answer with less irrelevant context.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch a basic example
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to fetch React useState examples and summarize the most useful pattern.

prompt_templates.title: Get conceptual documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch Prisma getting started documentation in info mode, then explain the setup steps in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Use a known library ID
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch documentation for /vercel/next.js about routing and return the key API patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Compare multiple pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch page 1 and page 2 for React hooks documentation, then merge the distinct examples and warnings.

output_examples.output: A concise response with selected React state examples, relevant API signatures, and any important notes from the documentation.

output_examples.input: How do I get started with Prisma queries?
output: Short overview of the query workflow.
Selected examples for common query methods.
Notes about required setup or version-specific behavior.

output_examples.input: Fetch Next.js routing docs for implementation guidance.
output_examples.output: Focused routing guidance with examples and key terms, without returning the full documentation page.

best_practices: Use specific topics such as routing, hooks, or aggregation for better filtering.
Use known Context7 library IDs when available to skip resolution.
Use info mode before code mode when learning a new library area.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to inspect local repository source code.
Do not treat filtered output as complete documentation coverage.
Do not run arbitrary stdio MCP commands from untrusted prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill fetch?
faq.answer: It fetches library documentation from Context7 and filters it into concise content for coding tasks.

faq.question: Does it read my local project files?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for published library documentation, not local repository exploration.

faq.question: Why does it use shell scripts?
faq.answer: The scripts keep large documentation responses in subprocesses and return only filtered sections.

faq.question: Can it fetch documentation for any library?
faq.answer: It can fetch libraries indexed by Context7. Unsupported libraries may return no useful results.

faq.question: Is network access required?
faq.answer: Yes. The Context7 MCP server and documentation lookup require network and npm package execution.

faq.question: Can I request more detail?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a broader topic, info mode, or additional pages for deeper coverage.
